items.title: John E. Wood Interview, 1986-06-26
items.q: John Casimir, when he would play for those funeral parades, I've seen him on, I perhaps shouldn't say many occasions, but certainly on more than one occasion

ctx.x: I was in the midst of it.

But that was always a striking and exciting thing is when at a funeral, and I really didn't go to a lot of funerals, maybe three or four, maybe a couple more, but that they would play that, the band and the club that was the deceased had been a member of, they would assemble somewhere a couple of blocks away and then they would have this warm-up fast number and kind of get right and then get over to the home or the funeral parlor and when they finally brought the casket out then they would go to the church where…

Yeah, I think we are getting close to the end of the tape, so I'll ask you three or four questions now to confuse you. I'll check it. Okay we got John Wood, Reel 2, and today is the 26th of June 1968.
